title: cache_miss
description: Close/event: a cache lookup miss at the given layer. Layer `etag` is the conditional-request answer at the transfer boundary: a hit there is the 304 decision, made before any resource runs.

durationMs.description: wall time from the scope opening to this close, in milliseconds. On a hit close this is what serving from the cache cost; on a miss close it is the resource run plus the write it triggered - so the pair says whether the cache is buying anything, and a hit that is not faster than a miss is a cache costing money for nothing. Null on a bare event: an inner lookup has no scope, so it has no duration to report and a zero would read as "instant". A measurement, not a contract: it moves with the machine, the pool and the payload.
